issues.title: Production DB applied an authorization migration from still-open PR #11
issues.description: The production migration ledger contains 20261103224708_phase_m_authorize_initial_content_admin; private reviewer and authorized user tables each have one row. PR #11 remains OPEN/NOT MERGED and Pages/main are at a50eaca.
evidence: origin/main and Pages deployment SHA a50eaca
issues.root_cause: Production database migration and Git main release state were not advanced atomically.
issues.recommendation: Have maintainers review PR #11, migration contents and authorization evidence; then reconcile main and migration ledger using the controlled release process. Do not rerun the already applied migration or change reviewer roles to hide drift.
acceptance_criteria: clean database replay matches production migration history
PR and production state are traceable
issues.impact_scope: Reviewer 授权、Phase M 审核发布、迁移重放和 main/production 环境一致性。

issues.title: No production candidate/audit records; repository-level Actions secrets are empty
issues.description: Publication manifest entries=0, practice_candidate_quality_records=0, repo-level GitHub Actions secrets and variables are empty, and the most recent candidate workflow prepare-pr job was skipped. Successful Pages verification is not proof that a candidate traversed the full publication chain.
evidence: workflow run 41732099172 prepare-pr SKIPPED; verify-pages SUCCESS
issues.root_cause: Workflow code exists but no auditable production candidate and repository-level release credential chain was demonstrated; organization secrets were not independently checked.
issues.recommendation: Use an isolated staging environment and least-privilege credentials to prove candidate -> deterministic validation -> independent Reviewer -> human approval -> PR -> Pages exact comparison -> registration. Never auto-merge.
acceptance_criteria: reviewer and human approval are distinct
registration occurs only after publication verification
candidate self-check never writes mastery evidence
issues.impact_scope: AI 候选生成、独立 Reviewer、人工审批、GitHub PR、Pages 发布核验和正式题库注册。

issues.title: Real Supabase cross-device learning sync has not passed production E2E
issues.description: Production learning_events=0, user_devices=1 and learning_archive_documents=3. Local cross-device browser E2E uses isolated/mock RPC services. No real production OAuth session wrote and read learning data on two devices.
evidence: Supabase read-only counts: learning_events=0; user_devices=1; learning_archive_documents=3
scripts/verify-backend-contract.mjs passed but is a contract test
issues.root_cause: Client algorithms and protocol are tested in isolation; production OAuth, account isolation, RLS and multi-device merge remain unaccepted.
issues.recommendation: Use a non-production Supabase project and test identities to execute login, event append, Outbox retry, pull/merge, CAS conflict, logout/revocation and cross-account denial on two devices.
acceptance_criteria: retries are idempotent and CAS conflicts handled
account A cannot read/write account B
mastery derives only from valid assessment events
issues.impact_scope: 学习事件、用户设备、Outbox、云端档案、掌握度与 Gap 跨设备恢复。

issues.title: Real model Provider execution for Tutor, Agent and Reviewer is unverified
issues.description: learning-agent ACTIVE v9 and practice-quality-review ACTIVE v3 with JWT verification. Source reads AI_PROVIDER_* and PRACTICE_REVIEWER_* variables; Supabase secret state/value was not accessible and no real model call was made.
evidence: no authenticated production model request performed
issues.root_cause: Deployed endpoints do not prove secret configuration, provider reachability or structured response correctness.
issues.recommendation: In staging verify real Tutor, Agent and independent Reviewer requests plus 401/403, timeout, 429, 5xx, invalid JSON and fail-closed behavior.
acceptance_criteria: provider failure never produces pass records
AI output does not directly mutate mastery
issues.impact_scope: AI Tutor、AI Learning Agent、独立 AI Reviewer 的模型调用、输出质量和失败安全。

issues.title: Nine of twelve knowledge topics lack a formal Concept/Competency/Assessment map
issues.description: Only Promise, Monorepo and React Native have formal Concept, Competency, Gap, prerequisite and Assessment models. Nine other topics have public pages but no equivalent graph.
evidence: content/concepts.json has 16 concepts, all in 3 topics
review-assessments=72 and checkpoints=14 only cover the same 3 topics
issues.root_cause: Topic directory expansion outpaced knowledge modeling and assessment coverage.
issues.recommendation: Select 2-3 high-value topics and build Concept -> Competency -> prerequisites -> assessment -> work links. Do not mass-generate weak maps.
acceptance_criteria: stable IDs for concepts and competencies
prerequisite DAG is justified and acyclic
each core competency has a learning entry and assessment
unmapped topics show no fake mastery
issues.impact_scope: 九个未建模专题的学习规划、掌握度、Gap 诊断、测评和 AI 知识上下文。

issues.title: All 72 formal Review Assessments lack difficulty metadata
issues.description: The difficulty field is undefined for all 72 review assessment records, preventing auditable difficulty bands and reliable adaptive difficulty selection.
issues.root_cause: Question schema carries prompt/options/answer/hints/explanation but no consistent difficulty metadata.
issues.recommendation: Define difficulty levels and cognitive-load tags, then fill through human review rather than inferring from titles.
acceptance_criteria: all items have a reviewed difficulty or explicit unclassified state
planner can explain the selected difficulty
issues.impact_scope: 72 道 Review Assessment 的难度分级、自适应排序和学习任务解释。

issues.title: Thirteen official references cover only three mapped topics
issues.description: All 13 source records belong to Promise, Monorepo and React Native. Other nine topics have no source registry records. All URLs returned HEAD 200; this is not a version/content match audit.
issues.root_cause: Source registration followed the three course builds, while the other topics lack reference governance.
issues.recommendation: Attach authoritative sources, versions, access dates and citation anchors to important claims; prioritize AI Agents, database, model infrastructure, math and engineering.
acceptance_criteria: dead links are checked in CI
issues.impact_scope: 九个知识专题的技术事实可追溯性、AI grounding 和版本维护。

issues.title: README route count and Phase M status are stale
issues.description: Root README reports 42 canonical routes while routes.json and the architecture validator report 44. README also describes content_admin provisioning as future work while production already contains a reviewer row; PR #11 is still open and repository Actions secrets are empty.
issues.root_cause: The root README has not been reconciled with registry, PR, database and secret state.
issues.recommendation: After PR #11 reconciliation, update the README and clearly separate reviewer row provision, PR status, Actions credentials, Provider configuration and actual publication acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: docs distinguish code, DB, secrets and deploy state
issues.impact_scope: 项目接管、路由总量、Phase M 交付判断和日常运维手册。

issues.title: Supabase Auth leaked-password protection is disabled
issues.description: Security Advisor reports auth_leaked_password_protection WARN. All seven public business tables have RLS and policies. Two private tables have RLS but no policies (INFO); confirm that private schema is not exposed through REST.
evidence: private reviewer/allowlist RLS no policy INFO
issues.root_cause: Auth leaked-password protection is not enabled; private schema exposure boundary needs recurring verification.
issues.recommendation: Evaluate and enable leaked-password protection; confirm private schema is not exposed and test anon/authenticated denial.
acceptance_criteria: anon/authenticated cannot read private reviewer/allowlist tables
issues.impact_scope: Supabase Auth 账户密码安全和 private reviewer/allowlist 数据暴露边界。

issues.title: Full semantic fact-check and teaching-quality review is not complete
issues.description: Asset census, route checks, registry relationship checks and automation completed, but no line-by-line factual audit of all 74 public pages, 72 question answers/explanations and 51 internal engineering docs was performed. Technical accuracy therefore remains UNVERIFIED.
evidence: no complete expert line-by-line review performed
issues.root_cause: Automated structure/behavior tests are not equivalent to fact checking each technical claim.
issues.recommendation: Review the three core courses page-by-page and question-by-question, record source/version dates, validate runnable snippets and check ambiguous questions.
acceptance_criteria: each published item has review status/evidence
issues.impact_scope: 74 个公开教学页、72 道 Review 题、14 个 Checkpoint、挑战和内部技术文档的可信度。

issues.title: Backup, restore and disaster-recovery drill have no evidence in this audit
issues.description: Project health, migrations and schema are accessible, but no backup retention, PITR configuration or successful restore drill was inspected.
evidence: no backup/PITR configuration or restore artifact observed
issues.root_cause: Operational restore proof is not part of the available handover evidence.
issues.recommendation: Check plan-specific backup/PITR, retention, RPO/RTO, and perform a restore into an isolated project.
acceptance_criteria: no test data written to production
issues.impact_scope: 用户学习事件、学习档案、任务和审批审计记录的灾难恢复能力。

issues.title: Mobile acceptance uses WebKit emulation rather than physical iPhone Safari
issues.description: Local Chromium/WebKit 390px viewports cover navigation, progress, Tutor, review and reviewer panels; no real iPhone Safari session on real network/account was performed.
issues.root_cause: Browser emulation cannot cover OS keyboard, system permissions, network and Safari lifecycle differences.
issues.recommendation: Run a staging-account acceptance on a physical iPhone Safari for learning, offline, restore, keyboard, permissions and weak network.
acceptance_criteria: core learning flow works on physical iPhone
two-device sync verified without production test data
issues.impact_scope: 移动端学习流程、Tutor、复习、审核面板和双设备切换体验。

issues.title: Production sitemap.xml returns 404
issues.description: robots.txt is reachable, but sitemap.xml returns 404. Public pages and canonical routes remain available.
issues.root_cause: Static Pages build does not generate sitemap.xml.
issues.recommendation: Generate sitemap from canonical routes and exclude hash-only/private routes.
acceptance_criteria: all public canonical pages included once
issues.impact_scope: 站点地图发现、搜索引擎索引和 canonical public pages 抓取。

issues.title: Supabase Advisor reports two unused indexes
issues.description: learning_events_user_occurred_idx and user_devices_last_seen_idx are marked unused; project is new and learning_events currently has zero rows, so indexes should not be deleted on that basis alone.
issues.root_cause: Current workload is too small to provide meaningful index usage evidence.
issues.recommendation: Review after production query plans and real workload are available.
acceptance_criteria: index decisions supported by EXPLAIN/workload data
issues.impact_scope: 学习事件和设备列表相关查询的索引成本与潜在性能。
